dct_description_sm: The ecosystems of Quttinirpaaq National Park have been dramatically affected by recent climate change. Certain ecosystems have responded gradually to climate warming, while others have seen catastrophic changes as they passed critical thresholds. Our ongoing research program seeks to understand the structure, biodiversity and function of the rare and complex ecosystems found in this northern-most region, and to evaluate their short- and long-term environmental responses as sentinels of global change.  This project is part of the ADAPT project (Arctic Development and Adaptation to Permafrost in Transition) and is linked to other projects (CCIN Reference Number: 79, 306, 10917, 10930).
dct_title_s: Northern Ellesmere Island in the Global Environment (NEIGE)
